760810101.text: I've heard that the legendary Starshyna, Sigurd, wielded a longsword, and his monster-slaying prowess was one of a kind.

760810102.text: He vanished in the wake of a great battle, and so this empty grave was built in his honor.

760810103.text: A purple blade and golden hair... He must be the wandering warrior who clashes with the Wild Hunt.

760810104.text: It seems his spirit has not been able to find rest in his grave, just like the many spirits in the Final Night Cemetery.

760810105.text: Raising his sword against the Hunt, the hero's spirit remains unwavering, even after death.

760810106.text: ...Sir Sigurd, you are a man worthy of my respect.

760810107.text: Yet, to fight in solitude for naught but hatred and one's sense of duty is far too cruel a fate for a warrior such as you.

760810108.text: Do you miss the days you shared drinks and songs with your fellow Lightkeepers, Sigurd? Have you any reason to wield your blade now, save a hunger to slaughter your foes?

760810109.text: If so, then show yourself. Let us spar, just like old times, just as it was in your days as a Lightkeeper.

760810301.text: Mr. Sigurd, I owe you my life. If you hadn't led the Lightkeepers south to hold the line back then, I might have died without even knowing how, and my body would be nowhere to be found...

760810302.text: But why has your spirit not found rest? Why are you still wandering, still fighting?

760810303.text: Tainted by the Wild Hunt's corruption, with your very form shattered... It seems you never truly left that battlefield, did you? For you, the war has never ended.

760810304.text: In that sense, perhaps I'm not so different from you. None of us will find true peace until the Wild Hunt is gone for good.

760810305.text: It's an honor to meet you, Mr. Sigurd.

760810306.text: I understand now. For a Lightkeeper, the best form of communication is done with blades in hand.

760810307.text: Then allow me to show you the strength of the new generation of Lightkeepers.

760810201.text: That was an excellent battle, Sir Sigurd.

760810202.text: Regrettable that this should be a hero's end.

760810203.text: To wander alone in the land you sacrificed your life for... Did you see this day coming when you first answered the Lightkeepers' oath?

760810204.text: Perhaps you did, and yet did not hesitate.

760810205.text: I will visit you again in the future. Farewell, Sir Sigurd.

760810402.text: Rest assured. After you and your comrades fell, my father Nikita took up the mantle of Starshyna and led the people you saved to rebuild the order.

760810403.text: Today, we are strong enough to protect this land even under the shadow of the Wild Hunt.

760810404.text: Your sacrifice was not made in vain. Your deeds and your will shall live on.

760810405.text: Farewell, Mr. Sigurd. I'll visit you from time to time. May you find your peace at last.

760819901.text: The way he vanquishes monsters... No, that figure of legend has long since given his life in the line of duty.

760819902.text: Could he have awakened again, somehow? Hmm... If you have a moment, go to the beach to the northeast of the Barrowmoss Barrens. That's where his grave is.

760819903.text: The old man once told me stories of the legendary Starshyna Sigurd, the one he fought beside years ago.

760819904.text: The violet blade, the golden hair... he's exactly as the tales described. The person I've seen these past days... could that really be him?

760819905.text: His resting place lies on the beach northeast of the Barrowmoss Barrens. If I have the time, I should go there for a look.
